Seymour Omnis BOSS BATTLE IN GAME DESCRIPTION: The four Mortiphasms behind him energise his spells, and where they point shapes his actions. Physical hits turn them left, magic turns them right. HP: 80,000 The discs hovering behind Omnis are the Mortiphasms. They turn as the fight goes on, and the colours nearest Seymour set the strength and element of his spells. Fire shows as orange or red, Lightning as yellow or green, Water as blue and Ice as purple. Seymour casts four spells a turn. If all four discs match, he casts the top-tier spell (Firaga, Thundaga, Waterga or Blizzaga) and absorbs that element when you cast it at him. He is also weak to the opposite element then. dboxTimeline.text: We flew into its mouth. The sea inside was red.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Welcome, Lady Yuna. Welcome into Sin.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: You. Again. How are you even still here?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Sin chose me. I am part of it now, and I am learning it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: You struck down Yunalesca. There is no Final Aeon now.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Nothing is left in Spira that can end Sin. Only me

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: We can. That's what we came here to do.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Then understand the price, son of Jecht.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Your death is your father's life. Come and pay it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: It moved! Hit 'em, and they turn, ya?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: He's gathering himself. Brace.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Your little blessings. Let me take them from you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Rest now. All of you, together.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: They all changed colour. Start again!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Rest now. All of you, together.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Rest now. All of you, together.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Pain is a gift, Lady Yuna. I give it back to you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Rest now. All of you, together.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Rest now. All of you, together.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: So. This is how it ends for me.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Yuna. Send him. Now, while he can't fight it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Yes.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: You think this ends the sorrow? It will outlive me

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: It outlives everyone, Lady Yuna. Even you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: ...Goodbye, Seymour.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Sin's next. My old man's waiting.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Then don't keep him waiting.
